title: What the Level Moved to Costs for the Days Still to Run, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
The cost of the level moved to follows the basis on which that level arrives at its fee, and the level moved
to is the level named on the guest's approved request to change level. The trip price for the days still to run
is the daily rate locked in on the trip, carried on the Keyturn Trip Booking, taken for each of those days.

1. Where the level moved to arrives at its fee as the greater of its daily amount and its share of the trip
   price, its cost for the days still to run is the greater of its daily amount for those days and its share of
   the trip price for those days.
2. Where the level moved to arrives at its fee as a share of the trip price, its cost for the days still to run
   is its share of the trip price for those days.
3. Where the level moved to arrives at its fee as a daily flat amount, its cost for the days still to run is
   its daily amount for those days.

The share of the trip price each level is written at:

| The level moved to | Share of the trip price |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0 percent |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 15 percent |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 25 percent |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 35 percent |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 45 percent |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 40 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical move with 12 days still to run on a trip whose locked-in daily rate is 130.00 USD, so the
trip price for those days is 1560.00 USD.

- On a level moved to whose daily amount is 38.00 USD and whose share is 35 percent, arriving at its fee as
  the greater of the two: the daily amount for those days is 456.00 USD and the share of the trip price is
  546.00 USD, so its cost is 546.00 USD.
- On a level moved to whose daily amount is 26.00 USD and whose share is 25 percent, arriving at its fee as the
  greater of the two: 312.00 USD against 390.00 USD, so its cost is 390.00 USD.
- On a level moved to arriving at its fee as a share of the trip price alone, written at 45 percent, its cost
  is 702.00 USD.
- On a level moved to arriving at its fee as a daily flat amount of 64.00 USD, its cost is 768.00 USD and the
  trip price does not enter it.
